Irfan Pathan predicts MS Dhoni's IPL 2027 auction presence

Former Indian cricketer Irfan Pathan has predicted that MS Dhoni will be present at the Chennai Super Kings' (CSK) table during the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2027 auction. Pathan's prediction suggests Dhoni's continued involvement with the franchise beyond his playing career. Separately, an England pacer is reportedly set to enter the IPL 2027 auction, attracting interest from the Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) and Punjab Kings (PBKS).
